import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_b62',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

def make_grid(n, lines, axis):
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for key,color in lines:
        for r in range(n):
            for c in range(n):
                q = r if axis=='row' else (c-r if axis=='d' else c+r)
                if q==key: g[r][c]=color
    return g

def expected(n, axis, period, pattern):
    return [[pattern[(r if axis=='row' else (c-r if axis=='d' else c+r))%period] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]

cases=[]
cases.append(('demo1',make_grid(6,[(1,6),(2,1),(3,3),(4,1),(5,7)],'row'),'row',5,[7,6,1,3,1]))
cases.append(('demo2',make_grid(26,[(1,7),(4,1),(6,9),(-16,3),(-19,3)],'d'),'d',7,[2,7,3,5,1,3,9]))
cases.append(('demo3',make_grid(22,[(8,9),(14,7),(23,8),(37,5)],'s'),'s',4,[9,5,7,8]))
cases.append(('demo4',make_grid(26,[(0,2),(6,1),(9,4),(11,1),(18,4),(20,3),(21,3),(23,5)],'row'),'row',8,[2,4,4,1,3,3,1,5]))
cases.append(('demo5',make_grid(10,[(-9,4),(-6,5),(-3,9),(-2,1),(3,3),(4,5),(8,8),(9,6)],'d'),'d',8,[8,6,5,3,5,9,1,4]))
for name,g,axis,p,pat in cases:
    got=mod.transform(g); exp=expected(len(g),axis,p,pat)
    print(name,got==exp)
